name: Saint Peter
contribution: One of the Twelve Apostles of Jesus and one of the first leaders of the early Christian Church.
legacy: Although the New Testament does not explicitly identify this person as the first bishop of Rome or detail his journey there, early Church Fathers and historians, including Irenaeus, Tertullian, Hegesippus, Clement of Alexandria, Lactantius, and Eusebius attest that this person spent his closing years in Rome, and along with Paul founded the Church in Rome and conferred the episcopal office upon Linus

checks.lead: Saint Peter (born Simon bar Jonah; c. 1 BC – AD 64/68), also known as Peter the Apostle, Simon Peter, or Cephas, was one of the Twelve Apostles of Jesus and one of the first leaders of the early Christian Church. He appears repeatedly and prominently in all four New Testament gospels, as well as the Acts of the Apostles. Catholic and Orthodox tradition treats Peter as the first bishop of Rome (or pope) and also as the first bishop of Antioch. According to Christian tradition, Peter was crucified upside down in Rome under Emperor Nero.
